bio: The venerable Gasthof Post has a series of charming Alpine-style dining areas, and in all of them the same à la carte menu is served: an ambitious selection of Austrian classics such as Tafelspitz and Wiener schnitzel, as well as international dishes. An exclusive fine dining set menu is served in the Jägerstube Thursdays to Sundays but you'll need to order in advance. Diners can also look forward to a good wine list and attentive service. Individually decorated guestrooms are available for overnight stays....
